messages:
Elaine: FYI customer running our new Rust SDK sees weird quota bursts even though they set max_concurrency=3. They use paginator with prefetch=4 and a slow consumer.

Omar: Rust SDK is new — does its prefetch enqueue respect backpressure?

Elaine: looks like prefetch writes into a bounded channel but the writer does a non-blocking try_send that drops backpressure when full. So pages pile up in memory and then get sent quickly when consumer frees up.

Vijay: that explains bursts. Which part applies throttle? at send time only?

Elaine: yes. Throttle checks only when the HTTP task is spawned, not when prefetch enqueues. So the queue can accumulate many ready-to-send tasks that bypass rate smoothing.

Omar: parity note: node+py block on enqueue when buffer full. Rust should do the same.

Vijay: short-term mitigation: ask customers to set prefetch=0 and reduce max_concurrency to 1 during migration. Also suggest a small processing delay as stopgap.

Elaine: opening an issue with repro and a tiny server that reports token consumption. I'll attach a trace showing spikes aligned with consumer wakeups.

docs-bot: Please include code examples for recommended settings in the pagination README.

Omar: core fix plan: change try_send -> send(await) so prefetch blocks on backpressure; expose prefetch and buffer_size as public options; make default prefetch=1 to match other SDKs.

Vijay: also add telemetry: prefetch_queue_depth, enqueue_block_time, and an alert if enqueue_block_time > 200ms for 30s. That will catch regressions in hosted.

Elaine: also found a related issue: retry logic in Rust spawns timers that call send_without_acquire on retry. Need to ensure retries acquire the same throttle permit and that permits are released in finally blocks.

Omar: good catch. include a unit test that simulates 429 + retry and asserts permit count returns to baseline.

Vijay: assign to @omar for the enqueue/refactor and @elaine for telemetry+tests. We'll coordinate parity tests with node/py.

devex-bot: Created issue #1788: "Rust SDK: prefetch try_send can cause backpressure bypass and quota bursts". CI job: https://ci.redwood.ai/job/1788-rust-prefetch-repro

Elaine: thanks. I'll update the customer once we have an RC. Also adding a short note in onboarding: "for long-running paginated jobs set prefetch=1 and call auth.ensure_fresh() beforehand."

Omar: one more UX idea: add a convenience helper `client.paginate_with_backpressure()` that sets conservative defaults for prefetch/buffer and adds telemetry hooks. Could ease onboarding.

Vijay: love it. Add to the backlog after the fix. Closing loop once PR merges.
